flags.why: This expression for 'ever/up to now' is mainly Southern Vietnamese.
This expression is mainly Southern Vietnamese, as recorded in the [Dictionary of Southern Vietnamese Words](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html).
This expression has vulgar sexual imagery, which the slang and derogatory tags do not warn learners about.
The slang expression means smart or clever, but does not mean elegant.
'Grow up to be somebody' suggests becoming successful or important rather than becoming a decent person.
flags.fix: The parents work hard so that their child will grow up to be a decent person.
